procedure: Replacing a Contaminated Filter in a Simulated Manufacturing Machine
modality: XR / AR overlay on a simulated machine cell
disclosure: Conceptual XR storyboard created independently as a portfolio demonstration.

fields.label: Scene Number
fields.value: FRAME 01

fields.label: Training Objective
fields.value: Establish the safe approach protocol and confirm work authorization before touching machine M-04.

fields.label: Environment
fields.value: Simulated factory-floor cell; neutral grey walls, machine M-04 at bay 2, ambient industrial lighting, yellow floor boundary.

fields.label: Learner Position
fields.value: Standing 3.0 m in front of the HMI, facing machine M-04.

fields.label: 3D Assets
fields.value: Machine M-04 shell, HMI panel, floor markings, PPE avatar hands, digital work-order placard, E-Stop mesh ESTOP_01.

fields.label: Initial Object State
fields.value: Machine in READY mode; virtual DANGER beacon off; work order loaded but unacknowledged.

fields.label: Instruction / Prompt
fields.value: “Review the work order, confirm the machine can be isolated, then point at the nearest emergency stop.”

fields.label: Learner Action
fields.value: Read the work order on the HMI; locate and highlight the E-Stop; state “E-Stop identified.”

fields.label: Correct Responses
fields.value: Highlights ESTOP_01 within 10 s; work order acknowledged; isolation permit confirmed.

fields.label: Incorrect Responses
fields.value: Skips the work order; selects the wrong control; attempts to open the housing while READY.

fields.label: Safety Condition
fields.value: Learner must remain outside the yellow boundary until LOTO is confirmed.

fields.label: Developer Notes
fields.value: Log time-to-identify via gaze/controller raycast; E-Stop collider id = ESTOP_01; gate all later steps on permit flag.

fields.label: Completion Condition
fields.value: Work order acknowledged AND E-Stop correctly identified.

frames.title: Locate & Identify the Contaminated Filter Housing

fields.label: Scene Number
fields.value: FRAME 02

fields.label: Training Objective
fields.value: Correctly identify filter housing F-2 among visually similar components.

fields.label: Environment
fields.value: Same cell; AR overlay mode projects asset-tag anchors over the machine front panel.

fields.label: Learner Position
fields.value: 1.2 m in front of the machine, slightly right of centre; crouching permitted.

fields.label: 3D Assets
fields.value: Filter housing F-2, lookalike vents F-1 and F-3, contamination decal, AR label anchors, asset-tag plate.

fields.label: Initial Object State
fields.value: Housing LEDs green; contamination indicator hidden until the learner inspects the housing.

fields.label: Instruction / Prompt
fields.value: “Find the filter housing flagged for replacement and confirm its asset tag ‘F-2’.”

fields.label: Learner Action
fields.value: Raycast/point at F-2; read the asset tag aloud; dismiss the two lookalike components.

fields.label: Correct Responses
fields.value: Selects F-2 and reads tag ‘F-2’; rules out lookalikes within 15 s.

fields.label: Incorrect Responses
fields.value: Selects F-1 or F-3; mistakes an exhaust vent for the filter; no tag read.

fields.label: Safety Condition
fields.value: No contact with surfaces above 40 °C; do not reach past the guard rails.

fields.label: Developer Notes
fields.value: Use two false-positive colliders; fade/haze lookalikes after a correct pick; log tag-read event.

fields.label: Completion Condition
fields.value: F-2 confirmed with an asset-tag read event logged.

fields.label: Scene Number
fields.value: FRAME 03

fields.label: Training Objective
fields.value: Apply the correct energy-isolation sequence before the housing is opened.

fields.label: Environment
fields.value: Factory cell; machine M-04 control cabinet at left-rear; isolation switch beside the cabinet.

fields.label: Learner Position
fields.value: Standing at the control cabinet, then at the isolation switch.

fields.label: 3D Assets
fields.value: Control cabinet, main isolator lever, padlock, tag, voltage probe, multimeter display, arc-flash PPE gloves.

fields.label: Initial Object State
fields.value: Machine READY; isolator UP (energized); no lock or tag attached.

fields.label: Instruction / Prompt
fields.value: “Isolate the machine, apply lock and tag, then verify zero-energy with the probe.”

fields.label: Learner Action
fields.value: Toggle the isolator DOWN; attach padlock and tag; probe all three test points.

fields.label: Correct Responses
fields.value: Isolator DOWN → lock + tag fitted → all 3 points read 0 V → state ISOLATED.

fields.label: Incorrect Responses
fields.value: Locks without toggling the isolator; skips the probe test; probes only one point; leaves the tag blank.

fields.label: Safety Condition
fields.value: Never open the housing before zero-energy is verified; arc-flash PPE required; stand clear of the cabinet.

fields.label: Developer Notes
fields.value: Gate housing interaction on the LOTO state machine = ISOLATED; log the order of probe readings.

fields.label: Completion Condition
fields.value: LOTO state ISOLATED and all probe readings equal 0 V.

frames.title: Open the Filter Housing Access Panel

fields.label: Scene Number
fields.value: FRAME 04

fields.label: Training Objective
fields.value: Open the access panel safely without damaging the seal.

fields.label: Environment
fields.value: Factory cell; lower front access panel of machine M-04.

fields.label: Learner Position
fields.value: Kneeling / crouched 0.8 m in front of the access panel.

fields.label: 3D Assets
fields.value: Access panel with four quarter-turn fasteners, hinge, warning decal, hold-open strut, tool tray.

fields.label: Initial Object State
fields.value: Panel secured; four fasteners at 0°; seal intact.

fields.label: Instruction / Prompt
fields.value: “Release the four fasteners in a cross pattern and swing the panel open. Do not force it.”

fields.label: Learner Action
fields.value: Loosen fasteners in order 1-3-2-4; open the panel; secure it with the hold-open strut.

fields.label: Correct Responses
fields.value: Cross-pattern order used; panel opens under control; hold-open strut engaged.

fields.label: Incorrect Responses
fields.value: Forces the panel; loosens in sequence 1-2-3-4; drops the panel; ignores the strut.

fields.label: Safety Condition
fields.value: Support the panel weight; keep fingers clear of the hinge pinch zone.

fields.label: Developer Notes
fields.value: Detect fastener order via twist gesture; raise a penalty if applied force exceeds threshold.

fields.label: Completion Condition
fields.value: Panel open, hold-open strut engaged, no seal-damage event recorded.

fields.label: Scene Number
fields.value: FRAME 05

fields.label: Training Objective
fields.value: Extract the contaminated filter and contain all contaminants.

fields.label: Environment
fields.value: Factory cell; open housing exposing the filter cartridge seated in the filter seat.

fields.label: Learner Position
fields.value: Crouched directly in front of the filter seat.

fields.label: 3D Assets
fields.value: Filter cartridge, retention clip, drip tray, sealed waste bag, contamination particle VFX, nitrile gloves.

fields.label: Initial Object State
fields.value: Cartridge seated and clipped; contamination decal on surface; drip tray empty.

fields.label: Instruction / Prompt
fields.value: “Release the retention clip, place the tray, then pull the cartridge straight out into the waste bag.”

fields.label: Learner Action
fields.value: Press the clip; position the drip tray; extract the cartridge; bag and seal it.

fields.label: Correct Responses
fields.value: Tray placed BEFORE removal; cartridge extracted straight; waste bag sealed.

fields.label: Incorrect Responses
fields.value: Pulls the filter without the tray; tilts the cartridge (debris spills); forgets to seal the bag.

fields.label: Safety Condition
fields.value: Keep gloves on; do not shake or compress the filter; avoid skin contact with residue.

fields.label: Developer Notes
fields.value: Particle system triggers a spill if tilt angle exceeds 25°; a waste-bag seal event is required.

fields.label: Completion Condition
fields.value: Cartridge removed, zero spill, waste bag sealed.

frames.title: Inspect Seat and Prepare the New Filter

fields.label: Scene Number
fields.value: FRAME 06

fields.label: Training Objective
fields.value: Verify the seat condition and stage the replacement filter correctly.

fields.label: Environment
fields.value: Factory cell; open housing plus an adjacent parts bench in the clean zone.

fields.label: Learner Position
fields.value: Standing at the bench, then returning to the housing.

fields.label: 3D Assets
fields.value: Filter seat, magnet, sealed new filter cartridge, gasket set, lint-free wipe, packaging scanner.

fields.label: Initial Object State
fields.value: Seat visibly used; new filter still sealed in its packaging on the bench.

fields.label: Instruction / Prompt
fields.value: “Inspect the seat for damage and debris, then unseal the new filter onto the clean tray.”

fields.label: Learner Action
fields.value: Wipe the seat; run the magnet for metal debris; unseal the filter onto the clean tray; check the part number.

fields.label: Correct Responses
fields.value: Seat wiped and debris-free; seal part number matches the work order; gasket present.

fields.label: Incorrect Responses
fields.value: Skips the seat inspection; opens the filter on the dirty floor; wrong part number; missing gasket.

fields.label: Safety Condition
fields.value: Confirm the machine is still ISOLATED (lock + tag visible) before re-entering the cell.

fields.label: Developer Notes
fields.value: Compare the scanned part number against the work order; randomly spawn debris for the inspection step.

fields.label: Completion Condition
fields.value: Seat inspected clean and correct part number unsealed on the clean tray.

frames.title: Install the New Filter and Reseal the Housing

fields.label: Scene Number
fields.value: FRAME 07

fields.label: Training Objective
fields.value: Install the filter and close the housing to specification.

fields.label: Environment
fields.value: Factory cell; open housing with the clean filter staged.

fields.label: Learner Position
fields.value: Crouched at the housing opening.

fields.label: 3D Assets
fields.value: New filter cartridge, retention clip, new gasket, access panel, four fasteners, torque gauge.

fields.label: Initial Object State
fields.value: Seat empty and clean; access panel open; new gasket staged on the tray.

fields.label: Instruction / Prompt
fields.value: “Seat the new filter, engage the clip, fit a new gasket, close the panel and torque the fasteners.”

fields.label: Learner Action
fields.value: Insert the filter; engage the clip; fit the gasket; close the panel; tighten the fasteners to spec.

fields.label: Correct Responses
fields.value: Filter fully seated; clip engaged with an audible click; fresh gasket fitted; torque within range.

fields.label: Incorrect Responses
fields.value: Reuses the old gasket; cross-threads a fastener; clip not seated; over- or under-torques.

fields.label: Safety Condition
fields.value: Do not pinch the gasket or seal; verify no tools are left inside the housing (FOD check).

fields.label: Developer Notes
fields.value: Torque range 4-6 N·m; haptic feedback on the clip click; tool-scan for foreign objects.

fields.label: Completion Condition
fields.value: Filter seated, fresh gasket fitted, torque in range, no foreign objects.

frames.title: Restore Power, Verify and Sign Off

fields.label: Scene Number
fields.value: FRAME 08

fields.label: Training Objective
fields.value: Return the machine to service and complete documentation.

fields.label: Environment
fields.value: Factory cell; control cabinet and HMI; sealed waste bag on the drip tray.

fields.label: Learner Position
fields.value: At the cabinet to remove LOTO, then at the HMI.

fields.label: 3D Assets
fields.value: Isolator switch, padlock and tag, HMI, waste bin, work-order form, green status beacon.

fields.label: Initial Object State
fields.value: LOTO state ISOLATED; access panel closed; sealed waste bag on the tray.

fields.label: Instruction / Prompt
fields.value: “Remove the lock and tag, restore power, run the verification cycle, then sign off and dispose of waste.”

fields.label: Learner Action
fields.value: Remove the lock/tag; set the isolator UP; run the cycle; confirm status; submit the work order; bin the waste.

fields.label: Correct Responses
fields.value: LOTO cleared; verification cycle passes; status READY; work order signed; waste disposed.

fields.label: Incorrect Responses
fields.value: Restores power with the lock still in place; skips the verification cycle; leaves waste in the cell.

fields.label: Safety Condition
fields.value: Ensure all personnel are clear before restoring power; the audible start warning must sound.

fields.label: Developer Notes
fields.value: Query telemetry for healthy differential pressure after the cycle; log the sign-off timestamp.

fields.label: Completion Condition
fields.value: Machine READY, verification passed, work order signed, waste disposed.
